name: Reference Echo Skill
purpose: Trivial reference skill: echoes a message N times and emits a schema-valid result envelope. Serves as the canonical worked example and health-check for the skill contract.

invocation.args_spec: Named params '-Message <string> -Repeat <int>', OR the generic convention '-InputsJson '<json object {message,repeat}>''. Optional '-ArtifactRoot <dir>' and '-InvocationId <guid>'.

inputs.name: repeat
inputs.description: How many times to repeat the message (must be >= 1).

outputs.description: { echoed, message, repeat, host, user, pwsh_version, pid }
